tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Behind the command window: the desktop or browser page it floats over, and full-page views.

tokens.name: window
tokens.usage: The command window and every panel inside it. text is 15.99:1 (night) and 18.26:1 (day) here.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Inputs, keycaps, the detail pane's evidence blocks, the action panel.

tokens.name: selected
tokens.usage: The selected row in a list. Every text and state token stays at or above 4.5:1 on it in both themes (lowest: text-3, 4.56:1 day).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between regions and around the window. Decorative only (1.31:1 night): never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Edges of keycaps and buttons, which their legend or label already identifies. Day is 3.39:1 on window, night 2.00:1: never the only thing that shows where an input is (that is line-input).

tokens.name: line-input
tokens.usage: The edge that alone shows where an input is: a field's box, a toggle's off track. At least 3:1 on window, raised and selected in both themes (lowest 3.02:1, selected at night), because at night raised is only 1.09:1 on window and the fill identifies nothing.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text in every voice, on canvas, window, raised and selected.

tokens.name: text-2
tokens.usage: Subtitles, secondary values, the agent's supporting sentences. At least 6.57:1 on any ground.

tokens.name: text-3
tokens.usage: Section labels, placeholders, key hints, timestamps. 4.58:1 (night) and 4.56:1 (day) on selected, its weakest ground.

tokens.name: you
tokens.usage: Kestrel rufous. Only what waits on you and the one action you are about to take: the ask mark, the primary action, the focus ring. 7.81:1 night, 6.09:1 day on window. Nothing else is this colour.

tokens.name: you-ink
tokens.usage: Text on a you fill (the primary button). 8.17:1 night, 6.09:1 day.

tokens.name: you-tint
tokens.usage: Background of a selected row that is an ask. text on it: 12.81:1 night, 15.71:1 day; you on it: 6.26:1 night, 5.24:1 day.

tokens.name: pass
tokens.usage: A measurement agreed: tests passed, a reviewer passed a criterion, a merge landed. Always with the pass mark, never colour alone.

tokens.name: fail
tokens.usage: A measurement disagreed or a part stopped, and the one destructive action in a panel (Reject). Always with the fail mark and a word. Close to you in lightness at night (1.18:1): told apart by shape (cross against diamond) and position, never by hue alone.

tokens.name: work
tokens.usage: An agent is working right now (engineer, architect, reviewer). The only colour of motion.

tokens.name: work-tint
tokens.usage: Fill of an agent's working time: an engineer's iteration blocks in the step level's lanes. Labels on it use text-2 (6.29:1 day, 6.65:1 night); text-3 is too faint on it in day (4.37:1).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind a sheet or the action panel's parent, at 70%.

tokens.name: you-hover
tokens.usage: The primary action under the pointer. you-ink on it: 7.32:1 day, 9.48:1 night.

tokens.name: you-press
tokens.usage: The primary action while pressed. you-ink on it: 8.60:1 day, 10.66:1 night.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The keyboard focus ring: 2px, 2px off the element, on every surface but an ink tile. At least 4.89:1 on every light surface in both themes.

tokens.name: focus-on-ink
tokens.usage: The keyboard focus ring on an ink tile, where you falls to 3.00:1 (day) and 2.05:1 (night). window on text: 18.26:1 day, 15.99:1 night.

tokens.name: thumb
tokens.usage: The selected option in a segmented control, lifted one step above its selected track. At night window is darker than selected and would read as a hole, so the thumb goes lighter instead. text on it: 18.26:1 day, 10.58:1 night.

styles.name: intent-display
styles.usage: The spec a page is about, once: the Factory level’s building spec.

styles.name: intent-xl
styles.sample: People can find a snippet by the words in it.
styles.usage: The sentence or name at the top of a page: the title row in your words, the intent a receipt answers.

styles.name: intent
styles.sample: Revoked links return 404, like links that never existed.
styles.usage: Your words as reading text: a spec document, your guidance as you write it, a spec named as a tile’s subject.

styles.name: intent-sm
styles.usage: Your words in a row: a spec named in a list, a sentence quoted under a name.

styles.name: statement-xl
styles.sample: Criterion 3 asks for 100 ms over 10,000 snippets.
styles.usage: The Stage’s speaker: what the agent in focus is saying, the one thing that frame is about.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: The title row’s name for a part or a page, and the title of the item a detail pane is about.

styles.name: statement
styles.sample: No test measures the 100 ms bound.
styles.usage: The one loud statement: the ink tile’s words, an agent’s last words.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: A detail pane’s name, a question put to you, a status as a tile’s headline.

styles.name: input
styles.sample: Ask kstrl, or type a command
styles.usage: The command input, and a short heading at 600: a notice’s title, the command window’s answer, a claim. Also at 600.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Every gate passed on try 2 of 4.
styles.usage: Reading text, row titles and names at 600, what agents said, the consequences of actions. Also at 600 and 500.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Pushes the branch and merges its PR.
styles.usage: Secondary text: a consequence under a choice, a hint, a tab, meta beside a title. Also at 500 and 600.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Section labels in text-3, captions, a sub-line under a title, a step’s label. Also at 400 and 600.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Chips and tags: a role, a kind, a count in a pill. Also at 400 and 500.

styles.name: stat-lg
styles.usage: The one number a page is about (today’s spend).

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: A tile’s number.

styles.name: stat-sm
styles.usage: A number in a small tile, or in a grid of tiles.

styles.name: measure-code
styles.usage: Code inside your words, where 13 would read small beside the serif.

styles.name: measure
styles.usage: A value: test counts, durations, diff stats, spend, commit ids, paths, code in a well. Also at 500 and 600.

styles.name: measure-inline
styles.usage: A measurement inside small text: the header’s spend and liveness, a token named in a caption. Also at 500 and 600.

styles.name: measure-small
styles.usage: Keycaps, a row’s accessories (its age, its tries), anatomy notes, a chart’s labels. Also at 400 and 600.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between a mark and its label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Row padding, gaps inside a row.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gaps between accessories; list inset.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Window edge padding, detail pane padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between blocks in a detail pane or plan.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page margins on full-page views such as a receipt.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Rows, keycaps, small buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Evidence blocks, the action panel, buttons, cells in the Part level grid.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: The command window and part cards on the Spec level.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Tiles on the map: the Factory bento, the Step stage and tiles, the Part level step tiles, the Spec text sheet.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards and lanes resting on canvas: a one-pixel line plus a barely visible lift.

tokens.name: shadow-window
tokens.usage: The floating command window.

tokens.name: shadow-panel
tokens.usage: The action panel and other popovers over the window.

duration.note: How long a change takes. Entrances run longer than exits; nothing that moves takes longer than 240ms except the two signals that are about time itself (fresh, typing).

tokens.name: dur-fast
tokens.usage: Colour and background changes: hover, press, selection. Short enough to feel immediate.

tokens.name: dur-base
tokens.usage: Something moving a short distance inside a control: the segmented thumb, the tab underline, the toggle knob.

tokens.name: dur-enter
tokens.usage: A surface arriving: the notice card, the action panel, a Needs-you item.

tokens.name: dur-exit
tokens.usage: A surface leaving. Faster than it arrived, so dismissing never waits on the animation.

tokens.name: dur-ring
tokens.usage: An iteration ring advancing one step, so the change reads as progress rather than a jump.

tokens.name: dur-typing
tokens.usage: One cycle of the typing indicator, while an agent's output is growing.

tokens.name: dur-fresh
tokens.usage: The change highlight: a selected background on exactly the value that changed, fading out.

easing.note: The curve of a change. Movement decelerates into place; exits accelerate away; fades that measure time are linear.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Movement within a surface: thumbs, underlines, knobs, the ring advancing.

tokens.name: ease-enter
tokens.usage: A surface arriving: fast start, soft landing.

tokens.name: ease-exit
tokens.usage: A surface leaving: gentle start, quick finish.

tokens.name: ease-linear
tokens.usage: Fades that stand for elapsed time: the change highlight, the typing dots.
